title: Sindh Ministers Salaries Allowances And Privileges Second Amendment Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Ministers Salaries Allowances And Privileges Second Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIII OF 1996
ACT XIII OF 1996
SINDH MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (SECOND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-IV, 24th April, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-7/96, dated
24-4-1996.---The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Second
Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on
15th April, 1996 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 24th April, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Second Amendment) Act,
1996.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 8-A of the Sindh Act VIII of 1975

ACT XIII OF 1996
ACT XIII OF 1996
SINDH MINISTERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (SECOND
AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act further to amend the Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-IV, 24th April, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-7/96, dated
24-4-1996.---The Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Second
Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on
15th April, 1996 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 24th April, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of
the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 8-A of the Sindh Act VIII of 1975.---In the
Sindh Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975, in section 8-A
for the words, figure and letters "Car Marcedes Benz 280 SEL or
equivalent", the words, figure and letters "motor car with engine
capacity up to 3200 CC" shall be substituted.
